items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Collection planning, textile and print design, apparel design and AI-assisted creative workflows, across apparel, home textiles, kids and resort wear.

items.q: How much experience do you have?
items.a: More than 13 years in fashion and textile design, with seven companies and a Brand Manager role at Firdous since 2026.

A Diploma in Textile Designing from ART ZONE Textile Designing Institute (2010) and an online Diploma in Fashion Designing from Alison (2012), plus certificates from Google, Urdu AI, UNESCO and Gemini.

items.q: Do you work on luxury and occasion wear?
items.a: Yes. I have done CAD layouts for high-end luxury collections, and I specialise in evening wear, party wear and detailed embroidery design.
